elements.name: AA-1, the first F-35A Lightning II prototype
Chief pilot Jon Beesley
elements.features: Average build; head silhouetted, obscuring hair colour, hairstyle, facial hair, and glasses.

voice.instructions: Use a mature, mid-low male register with a measured pace, neutral American accent, and a steady, lightly gravelly texture; stay calm, precise, and understated without imitating any real person.
voice.descriptor: Mature male voice with a mid-low pitch, measured pace, neutral American accent, and a steady, lightly gravelly timbre; calm, precise, and understated.
voice.why: Ash’s low, dry, measured delivery closely matches the requested mature, restrained pilot performance.
voice.sample_text: My name is Chief pilot Jon Beesley. In the opening two seconds, a widescreen live-action view shows AA-1, the first F-35A Lightning II prototype, lifting off at Lockheed Martin in Fort Worth, Texas, at 12:44 p.m.

elements.name: Lockheed Martin in Fort Worth, Texas

voice.instructions: Use a mature adult documentary delivery: calm, clear, and unhurried, with a low, even tone, neutral American accent colouring, and natural pauses.
voice.descriptor: a calm documentary narrator for this film: measured, clear, unhurried
voice.why: Sage’s calm, low register provides an unobtrusive documentary narration.
voice.sample_text: F-35A Lightning II — First Flight. A short film from the record.

fort-worth-airfield.light: Natural daylight across the entire aerial view; slightly hazy, muted blue-green colour, with soft but visible shadows beside trees and buildings. No artificial lighting is visibly illuminated.
fort-worth-airfield.floor: Exterior terrain: pale grey concrete runways, taxiways, aprons and roads; extensive green grass, wooded patches, residential plots and grassy river embankments.
fort-worth-airfield.walls: No interior walls visible. Distant industrial buildings have light grey or off-white exterior walls; smaller residential buildings are too distant for wall finishes to be distinguished.
